turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had diffuse (widespread) muscle pain. I’ve also had a fever, diarrhea/increased stool frequency, and involuntary weight loss over the last 3 months.
What is your age, and are you experiencing true muscle weakness (inability to generate normal force) or just muscle pain without weakness?
I don’t know. I can tell you I’ve had diffuse (widespread) muscle pain.
What is your age, and have you noticed any skin changes such as a rash, purple discoloration around the eyes, or reddish bumps over your knuckles?
Yes—I’ve had lesions, redness, or skin problems that I believe are related to this condition, including a pale-colored rash.
Have you experienced any joint pain, swelling, or stiffness, particularly in the mornings?
I don’t know.
Have you had any difficulty with daily activities like standing up from a chair, climbing stairs, or lifting your arms above your head?
I don’t know. I can tell you I’ve had diffuse (widespread) muscle pain.
Where on your body is the rash located, and is it itchy or painful?

It’s on the lower gum, labia majora (right), internal cheek (right), internal cheek (left), and bottom lip (right). The rash isn’t very itchy or painful for me—itching is 0/10 and rash swelling is 0/10. The pain intensity from the rash is 4/10.
What is your age, and are these mucosal lesions open sores/ulcers, blisters, or raised flat patches?

I don’t know. I can tell you I’ve had lesions and redness on my lower gum, labia majora (right), internal cheek (right), internal cheek (left), and bottom lip (right), with a pale-colored rash. The rash itching is 0/10 and rash swelling is 0/10, and the pain intensity from the rash is 4/10.
Have you noticed any blood in your stool, severe abdominal cramping, or eye symptoms such as redness, pain, or blurred vision?
I don’t know. I’ve had diarrhea or an increase in stool frequency, but I don’t know about any blood in my stool, severe abdominal cramping, or any eye symptoms like redness, pain, or blurred vision.
Have you noticed that your symptoms worsen with sun exposure, or have you developed a rash on sun-exposed areas like your face or upper chest?
I don’t know.

I don’t know. I’ve had diffuse (widespread) muscle pain, a fever, diarrhea/increased stool frequency, involuntary weight loss over the last 3 months, and lesions/redness/skin problems I believe are related to this condition, including a pale-colored rash on my lower gum, labia majora (right), internal cheek (right), internal cheek (left), and bottom lip (right). The rash isn’t very itchy or swollen for me (itching 0/10, swelling 0/10), but the pain intensity from the rash is 4/10.
Are these mucosal lesions recurrent ulcers that heal and come back, or have they been persistent continuously for the 3 months?
I don’t know.
Have you had any episodes of blurred vision, eye pain, or seeing floaters?
I don't know.
Have you had any abdominal pain, particularly cramping or pain in the lower right side, or any sores, fissures, or drainage around the anus?

I don’t know. I haven’t specifically noticed abdominal pain like cramping or pain in the lower right side, or any sores, fissures, or drainage around the anus. I can tell you I’ve had diarrhea or an increase in stool frequency.

[ABSTAIN] Insufficient discriminating information to distinguish between systemic inflammatory conditions with mucocutaneous involvement. Critical missing details include: specific morphology of mucosal lesions (ulcers vs. vesicles vs. plaques), recurrence pattern, presence of arthritis/arthralgia, ocular involvement, and objective muscle weakness.

[POSSIBLE] Behçet disease, Crohn disease, Systemic lupus erythematosus, HIV/AIDS with opportunistic infections, Systemic vasculitis
